title: Lossless P03.2 reading projection and inherited formatter repair
decision:
The complete 1168-row TSV remains the transfer tool's unchanged source. Its executor reading
input is `artifacts/P03/module-map.execution.json`: a lossless grouped representation with
source SHA-256, package PSR-4 roots, directory/role/rule dictionaries and every filename/symbol.
The projection checker reconstructs all eight original columns and compares every row,
including all 278 moves and every unchanged row. Any stale hash, missing row, changed role,
path, symbol or rule fails. Thresholds, calibration and transfer work remain unchanged.

Only P03.2 Inputs replaces the full TSV reading carrier with this representation; the full
TSV is still named in Intent/Scope/Code Guidance and consumed by the existing transfer.
The checker becomes an explicit before/after acceptance command. This narrows transport
without reducing evidence or product scope. The helper and projection are owned by P03.2.

As assigned in D60, Pint fixes the four inherited formatting findings in `p03-adapters.php`.
Its parsed AST must be identical to HEAD before transfer; no operation, value or check changes.
The bounded amendment is finished and independently reviewed before product transfer.
rationale:
The ready successor's bundle exposed a 119306-token reading carrier and 184714-token aggregate.
Repeated prefixes caused this transport defect; exact reconstruction preserves the complete
map rather than dropping rows or raising limits. The adapter's formatting is pre-existing
and must be fixed for P03.2's binding full lint check.
